ideas.name: Treasury Auction Relative Value
ideas.claim: A duration-matched Treasury portfolio changes direction around 2-year Treasury note auctions.
ideas.quote: On this day, the investor takes reverse positions and holds them for the next 10 days after the auction.

rules.market: U.S. 2-year and 10-year Treasury notes and 6-month Treasury bills
rules.timeframe: Daily; 10 days before and 10 days after the auction
rules.entry: Ten days before the auction, short 2-year notes and go long a duration-matched portfolio of 10-year notes and 6-month Treasury bills.
rules.exit: Reverse positions on the auction day and close the reversed positions 10 days after the auction.

not_stated: whether the 10 days are calendar or trading days
test period for the described three-leg strategy
ideas.claimed_result: not stated for the described three-leg strategy; the page's displayed backtest uses a different, 10-year-note-only implementation.
